name: member.read_savings_balance
title: Read a member's savings balance
description: Looks up a member by ID in the back-office console and returns the balance of their savings account.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: The member's ID number as shown in the console

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: Current balance of the member's savings account, in dollars

fallbacks.note: same role, relaxed to substring match — survives a relabel or added suffix
label association — works when the accessible name is computed differently

steps.discoveredBecause: Enter the provided member ID into the search field.

fallbacks.note: same role, relaxed to substring match — survives a relabel or added suffix
visible text — last resort, may match non-interactive elements

steps.discoveredBecause: Submit the entered member ID to find the member profile.
Capture the balance from the SAVINGS row. [recorder: the observed value was replaced by the relational SAVINGS × Balance target]

businessOutcomes.description: No member exists with the supplied ID. A legitimate answer, not a failure.

detect.description: Search page shows a not-found message

businessOutcomes.description: The record is restricted and this operator may not view it.
The application rejected the supplied input.

The member exists and is viewable, but holds no savings account. A legitimate answer to 'what is their savings balance', and the caller needs to be able to tell it apart from 'the automation could not find the field'.

conditions.description: We are on a member profile
...and the accounts grid has no SAVINGS row

detect.description: On a member profile with no SAVINGS account

businessOutcomes.description: The session timed out. Terminal for this run: re-authentication is the caller's concern, not something automation should attempt with stored credentials.

recoveries.description: A scheduled-maintenance interstitial appears over the member profile.
The page is taking unusually long. Wait once before treating it as a failure.

tenantOverlays.note: Same vendor product, different branding. The member-id field is labelled 'Member Number' here; the base descriptor's contains-match fallback covers it, so no override is needed. If the label diverged further, the override would go here rather than in a new artifact.

approval.note: Read-only capability approved after cross-member, recovery, and tenant replay verification.

provenance.goal: Look up the member with the given member ID, open their profile, and read the current balance of their SAVINGS account. Capture it as the output 'savingsBalance'.
